title: FSVoip push payload
description: Everything FullStack Studio puts in a push to an FSVoip app lives in one object called `fsvoip`. APNs carries it as a top-level key of the payload, FCM as a JSON string in `data.fsvoip`. Platform neutral: both apps decode the same object. A push NEVER contains the SIP password, a device token or a push token.

ring.description: Incoming call. On iOS this is a PushKit (VoIP) push and the app MUST report a CallKit call immediately in the PushKit callback. The matching SIP INVITE carries the header `X-FSS-Call: <callRef>`. If no INVITE arrives before `expiresAt` the app ends the call as unanswered.

callRef.description: FreeSWITCH call UUID, equal to the `X-FSS-Call` SIP header of the INVITE.

number.description: Caller number as the PBX knows it; null = anonymous.

name.description: Caller name from the PBX caller id; null = unknown.

accountId.description: `account.id` from the pair response (the app pairing).

accountLabel.description: The label of the dialled account, for display on the call screen.

expiresAt.description: Around 12 seconds after the push was created.

revoked.description: The pairing was revoked server side (portal, admin, MCP, or another phone took over). Sent as a regular alert push (iOS: to the alert token), NEVER as a VoIP push. The app removes the account.

refresh.description: Labels or contact lists changed; the app re-reads `GET /me`. Regular push, never a VoIP push.

apnsVoipBody.description: APNs payload of a VoIP push (`apns-push-type: voip`, topic `nl.fullstackstudio.fsvoip.voip`, `apns-expiration: 0`). No `aps.alert`.

apnsAlertBody.description: APNs payload of a regular notification (`apns-push-type: alert`, topic `nl.fullstackstudio.fsvoip`).

fcmMessage.description: FCM HTTP v1 request body. The `fsvoip` object travels as a JSON string in `data.fsvoip`.
